_comment: OSM .osm.pbf source extracts per region id (matches tiles/regions.json). Kept separate from regions.json so the display tiles pipeline (deploy-tiles.sh) is unaffected and never leaks these into manifest.json. deploy-routing-tiles.sh downloads each region's sources, osmium-merges them when there's more than one, then runs tilemaker clipped to the region bbox. Continent-level Geofabrik extracts are used: regions whose bbox is a sub-area of a continent (me, sas) read the whole continent and let tilemaker's --bbox clip; cross-continent regions (eas, sea-oc) merge two extracts. These are large weekly downloads — see the workflow header for the cost note.
